data.name: Sabitah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'S-B-T' which means to press, to put under pressure, to stabilize, Sabitah is a name that symbolizes stability, steadfastness, and constancy. It is a name given to a child born under the belief that she will grow up to be a strong and reliable individual.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual attribute of steadfastness, and the ability to remain grounded and focused on one's spiritual path despite external distractions and challenges.
data.numerology_meaning: Represents the completion of a cycle and the beginning of a new one. Those with a life path number of 9 are natural leaders, humanitarians, and creators.
